hero.eyebrow: Sereine · skincare, made in small batches
hero.title: One serum,
hero.lede: A barrier serum with niacinamide, hyaluronic acid, squalane and peptides, and nothing to make it smell nice. Scroll to see a bottle made and a drop go in.

stages.c: Violet glass that keeps light out, so the actives stay as strong on the last drop as the first.
Four actives, measured to the gram, each poured and mixed before the next goes in.
pH checked at 5.5, the same as healthy skin, then capped under a dropper that measures one drop at a time.
One drop is enough for the whole face. Press it in with your fingertips; don't rub.
Water-light, so it sinks in within a minute and leaves nothing on the surface.
The barrier holds more water and the surface looks smoother. Results vary; give it a month.

routine.title: Two questions,
routine.sub: Tell us your skin and what's bothering it. We'll lay out a morning and an evening routine from our range, in the order you put them on.

concerns.why: Niacinamide evens tone over a few weeks; the retinal at night speeds up how often skin renews itself.
Niacinamide calms oil and redness. Retinal keeps pores clear; build up slowly so it doesn't sting.
Peptides and retinal both support firmer-looking skin. Be patient: give it twelve weeks.
Squalane and ceramides repair the barrier, which is usually where redness starts. No retinal for now.

routine.note: Patch test anything new on your inner arm for two days. Always finish your morning with sunscreen.
routine.cta: Add this routine to the bag

ingredients.title: Everything inside,
ingredients.sub: We print the percentage of every active, because a name on a label means nothing without it. Pick one to see what it does and what it works with.

list.what: Evens tone, calms redness and helps the skin hold on to water.
list.from: Made in a lab, identical to vitamin B3

list.what: Two sizes of molecule: one hydrates the surface, one sinks a little deeper.
An oil your skin already makes. Softens without clogging.
Short chains of amino acids that support firmer-looking skin over time.
list.avoid: Strong acids in the same step

list.what: A fast form of vitamin A. Smooths texture and fine lines.
list.avoid: Exfoliating acids on the same night

list.what: The fats between skin cells. Replacing them repairs the barrier.
